subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: The Anima and Animus
description: A fast breakdown of The Anima and Animus for builders.

hook.text: Jung claimed every man carries a hidden feminine self and every woman a hidden masculine self.

buildup.text: He called them anima and animus—unconscious gender opposites that shape attraction and creativity.

discovery.text: Myths encode this: Shiva is half-female as Ardhanarishvara. Plato said humans were once whole.

twist.text: Modern gender theory challenges the binary. But the idea of inner opposites seeking integration persists.

climax.text: Whether gendered or not, the archetype points to a truth: wholeness requires embracing opposites.

punchline.text: Your other half lives inside you.

quiz.question: What is the anima in Jungian psychology?
options: The masculine side of a woman
The feminine side of a man
